headline: The State Bank of Pakistan has completed a multimillion-dollar upgrade of its digital infrastructure using technology from US firm Cisco, the US Embassy said on Friday, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Naya banking network aur data center bina rukawat ke lag gaya

caption:
State Bank of Pakistan ka digital nizam upgrade ho gaya!
Arab News ke mutabiq US Embassy ne Friday ko bataya ke State Bank ne US firm Cisco ki technology se apne digital infrastructure ka multimillion-dollar upgrade mukammal kar liya hai. Is mein naya banking network aur data center shamil hai, jo bank ke rozana kaam roke baghair lagaya gaya.
Kya is se aap ki online banking zyada mehfooz hogi? Comment mein batayein 👇
